static_traits.name: Wesley
static_traits.family_status: Lives with parents and a young sibling
static_traits.social_status: 有朋友可交谈,但尚not yet与任何人分享not足感与自我批评;因需要外部认同与自我比较,Interpersonal relationships趋于紧张
static_traits.medical_history: No major physical illness;此前not yet出现类似心理问题;not yet接受过心理治疗或心理咨询
static_traits.language_features: 表达清晰,逻辑较好,但整体语气消极与怀疑;自我贬损与负面标签化明显;倾向聚焦负面反馈,忽视正面信息;比较他人;配合度Average

basic_info.main_problem: 我正挣扎于not足感和自我批评,尤其与社交媒体存在感和自我形象相关.
basic_info.core_demands: I decided to seek counseling because these feelings are affecting my mental health and occupying my thoughts, affecting my daily life and relationships.
growth_experiences: 几个月前注意到Instagram帖子互动量下降,由于自己高度看重他人对社交媒体存在感的看法,逐渐产生not足感与Self-doubt;起初压力中等,但随后升级,影响自尊与对自我价值的判断,发布内容not yet达Anticipation就trigger负面情绪.
在动物素描方面收到具体负面反馈(如'动物的腿看起来not自然''比例与解剖存在问题'),该反馈被内化为对整体能力的negate,负面评论在心中更为显著,导致对动物相关创作失去动力;同时出现将自己视为'并非真正的Artist,只是自我欺骗'的Fear.

core_beliefs: I am not good enough/not值得

special_situations.event: 在Instagram发布作品后,浏览量与互动明显低于Anticipation
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果社交媒体互动偏低,就说明I have no value或not够好
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Adjusting the content and frequency of posts, changing fitness and outward presentation, proactively seeking others' recognition and affirmation
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: The views are so low; I am just an idiot / terrible

special_situations.event: 收到关于动物绘画的负面或挑剔反馈(如'腿看起来not自然')
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果do not人指出缺陷,就证明我整体not行,not是真正的Artist
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Doubles practice, follows online tutorials; at the same time avoids or reduces animal-related creating
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I am not good enough,是在自欺欺人地以为自己会画动物

special_situations.event: 想到与朋友分享not足感与Self-doubt时,担心对方的反应
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我表达脆弱,do not人就会轻视我或把我当成在抱怨
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Avoiding sharing with friends, keeping silent to avoid being ignored or slighted
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: They will not understand me,只会not当回事

special_situations.event: Recalling praised works (such as a painting of a tiger) and positive feedback
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 只有所有作品都完美才算合格;个do not成功not算数
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Ignores or belittles positive evaluations, continues self-criticism to force herself to improve
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 少数好的not代表我真的行

core_conflict.wish: 渴望被看见,被认可与被肯定为'真正的Artist',并被严肃对待
core_conflict.fear: 害怕被negate,被轻视或被not当回事;担心在比较中显得not如人并暴露not够好
defense_goal: Maintains self-worth by seeking external approval
Avoiding expressing vulnerability to reduce the risk of being looked down on
Uses self-criticism and higher standards to gain a sense of control over failure

object_relations.self_representation: Vulnerable, someone who may be misunderstood
object_relations.object_representation: not会理解,可能轻视或把自己当抱怨的朋友群体

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When the counselor emphasizes one's successful cases or positive feedback and invites integrating them into self-evaluation
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 来访者倾向认为这些正面证据只是偶然或not算数,担心咨询师在忽视'真实问题'
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: 以客观,冷静的语气陈述'逻辑',淡化情绪体验;强调证据not足,举反例,弱化对积极体验的感受.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: 当被邀请考虑与朋友分享自身not足感与Self-doubt时
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 将自己的被轻视Fear归于他人,认为朋友会not理解或把自己当成在抱怨(移情:Projection)
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: use假设性措辞('他们会...''他们都...'),避免描述自身当下感受;语气谨慎,含糊其辞,少用第一人称体验.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When recalling or discussing critical feedback pointing out technical flaws in the work
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 将对他人的not满或挫败转为自我指责,认为缺陷意味着自己整体not行
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: use自我贬损语句(如'我就是not行'),承担全部责任,语气低落,减少对外部因素的讨论.

manifestations: Tightly binds self-worth to social media engagement volume
Negative feedback is highly internalized, positive feedback is hard to experience and integrate
对'是否是真正的Artist'产生存在性怀疑
outcomes: 持续的not足感与自我批评

manifestations: Worries about being looked down on or treated as complaining; chooses to avoid expressing vulnerability
outcomes: 支持系统not yet被有效利用

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'.
manifestations: Frequent self-criticism and labeling (such as 'I am an idiot')
在咨询中对积极证据保持怀疑,强调自身not足

contact_model.definition: The individual attributes feelings they find hard to accept to others, corresponding to 'possession'. Language manifestations include: 'He is looking down on me', 'They want to exclude me', and so on.
manifestations: Anticipation朋友会not理解或轻视自己,从而回避分享
Treats others' possible reactions as certain negative outcomes

contact_model.definition: The individual ignores or avoids a stimulus from the internal or external environment, deliberately avoiding direct contact, corresponding to 'acceptance'.
manifestations: 以怀疑态度弱化深入探索(如'我not确定这有多大帮助')
When touching on pain points, shifting to generalization or theorizing, reducing emotional contact

exception_events.target_problem: 在创作动物题材或发布作品时,来访者通常会因负面反馈或互动not达Anticipation而Self-denial并丧失动力.
exception_events.unique_outcome: Once completed a tiger work and obtained much positive feedback; the audience praised the expressiveness of its fur details and eyes, showing they possess solid ability and aesthetic presentation.
exception_events.reason: 线索:在该作品中更关注细节与眼神表现;题材与当时skill匹配;受众反应积极,形成Reinforcement.

positive_force: 有成功作品与skill基础(虎的作品得到好评,细节与表现力突出)
Has investment in practice and learning (follows online tutorials, tries to improve)
具备潜在的朋友支持网络(虽not yetuse,但可动员)
negative_force: Excessive reliance on external recognition to define self-worth (External Validation)
倾向negate正面反馈,聚焦负面(Disqualifying the Positive)
比较他人并自我标签化,增强not足感
Predictive worry about sharing vulnerability and mind reading (Fortune Telling/Mind Reading), leading to avoidance

antecedent: 发布作品后互动量低于Anticipation
收到负面或挑剔反馈(如动物腿not自然)

target_behavior.function: 逃避被他人negate的痛苦(先发制人的Self-denial),短期获得控制感或他人安慰

When seeing peers' work or higher engagement
